reviews.author: Virginia Thomas
reviews.text: LP painting services went above and beyond on refreshing our new home. His team was extremely courteous, prompt, worked so hard & efficiently to get our interior pretty much entirely repainted, drywall repair, and new light fixtures. His pricing was fair and for the quality of work I am extremely pleased with the outcome. His team gave me a run down every single day of what they were doing, and every day leaving of what they did & what was the plan for the next day. I am so thankful for this partnership I now have with a trusted team to help me with any future projects. 10/10 LP. We love our new home!

reviews.author: Branson Rathbone
reviews.text: Lonnie was great. Scheduled the job well out into the future so we could leave the house for a week while they worked. Had the whole interior repainted from ceilings to walls, crown molding, chair rail, baseboards, and doors.. they also did a great job repairing old drywall tape lines and nail pops. The interior looks brand new. Decent pricing as well.

reviews.author: Down Kenyon-smith
reviews.text: Superb work! Lonnie was wonderful to work with. He and his crew completed our painting job while we were out of town and it was exciting to return to see the beautiful finished product! His crew was respectful of our property and left our home in great condition when they were finished! Lonnie strives for excellence and quality work and I had no doubt we would be satisfied. I was so impressed with Lonnie that I hired him right away after he stopped by for an estimate and cancelled a second estimate I had scheduled for the next day! Would highly recommend LP Painting and will definitely use again for other projects!

reviews.author: Jay Recto
reviews.text: Feels like a new home. We recently got LP Painting to paint our house. The guys did outstanding job! Great service; fast and meticulous workmanship. The crew was very courteous of living space and cleaned up every night after the work was done. Loni, and crew were awesome to work with! I would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Cloverleaf Nook
reviews.text: We had a great experience with LP Painting Services & Home Improvements! Lonnie came out the same day we called, gave us a quote on the spot, and completed the job ahead of schedule. His team was professional, efficient, and did a phenomenal job on our storefront. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: joe brown
reviews.text: Can't say enough!! Lonnie and the crew did an excellent job taking care of things we needed done at Bethsaida Methodist Church in Brightwood Va. They sanded, primed and painted the metal roof. Glazed and painted the windows, painted the chimneys, exterior doors and foundation. Sanded and painted all metal hand rails.They also fixed the damage flooring in our restrooms, installed new flooring and painted the restrooms and main foyer. Lonnie was great providing the estimate and scheduling the work and stayed with the job until everything was completed. When the job was completed the crew did an outstanding job cleaning everything. Again Lonnie and the crew went above and beyond and it was great to have a contractor that did what he said he would do and more. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Jessica Beveridge
reviews.text: Loni & crew did such a fantastic job painting the majority of the interior of our home. They were quick, but they still had fantastic attention to detail! The whole crew were kind & courteous and worked hard to make a 3-4 day job into a 2 day job. Everything looks so fantastic. I thought their pricing was fair and worth every penny. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Erica Babich
reviews.text: I can not stay enough about Loni and his crew. They showed great attention to detail and professionalism. We had the main floor painted including the 2 story family room and foyer, banisters, and outside window repairs. Loni was willing to accommodate all of my requests and helped my house feel like a home. Beautiful work!

reviews.author: Thomas Martin
reviews.text: My name is Tommy Martin the owner of The Paint Bucket. I have known Loni going on 30 years. He is a good communicator as well as a problem solver. The material he uses is top quality Benjamine Moore paints. Every contractor thinks differently about the quality of paint they will use, Loni defaults to the premium line within Benjamine Moore attesting to the quality of work that he performs for his clients. The employees that he has are all very qualified. He communicates well with proposals, written contracts and has the clients best interest at heart. He works neatly, sanding in between coats and applying proper top grade caulk as well as wood repair and replacement both interior and exterior There is a particular review which I feel doesn’t match Loni’s reputation. I am writing this review to reinforce the professionalism of LP Painting.

reviews.author: Michelle Brown
reviews.text: We contracted Loni to paint our family home. It is an older two-story home and has been in our family for several generations. It was falling into disrepair and needed a complete exterior paint job. LP painting did a fantastic job painting the house and the metal roof. The house looks wonderful! Loni and his crew were very thorough in their preparation of the home for painting - pressure washing, sanding, scraping, priming, and caulking. Throughout the process, they were courteous and professional. Loni also communicated well with us and answered any questions that I had. I would definitely recommend them to others - and will use them for any future painting projects.

reviews.author: Janet Jolliff
reviews.text: We highly recommend this company. We have used them twice, first to paint the entire interior of our home and now our cabinets! Very professional, reasonable, clean, reliable. We would use them again in a heart beat!

reviews.author: Cheryl Carawan
reviews.text: We were thrilled with the service we received from LP Painting. I called, they came out the next day and gave us a price, and sanded and painted our double decker deck and adjacent porch two days later while we were out of town. He wouldn’t let us pay until we returned and were happy with their work. Five stars! We will definitely use Lonnie and his crew again!

reviews.author: Holland Markwalter
reviews.text: Loni and his teams are wonderful! They did an amazing job painting the exterior of our home to perfection down to every detail. They take pride in the quality of their work and took care of my property. I deeply appreciate the care they took while working around all my flowers and plantings. Loni is very responsive throughout the process and his teams have been with him for years…..some individuals for decades.

reviews.author: Jackie Fields
reviews.text: Man loni and his crew is the absoulte best !!!! They painted my interior of my house and did a wonderful job very clean and reapectful the guys cleaned up after they left and i tell you the are very accurate . Loni is wonderful hes very patient and will go over everything before and after the job to make sure your happyand everything is accurate , I highly recommend lp painting hes the best hands down !!

reviews.author: Blake Downs
reviews.text: We hired LP Painting Services recently to paint our kitchen cabinets, as well as our staircase rails/spindles. Loni gave us a very competitive price! He and his crew were professional, courteous, on time, and did an amazing job. We couldn’t be happier with the results . I highly recommend LP Painting Services & Hime Improvement

reviews.author: Kenneth Johns
reviews.text: Lonnie at L&P is the best!! His crew is talented, hard working, friendly and courteous. I used L&P about 10 years ago to paint a few rooms in our home, and I’d never seen such pros. I called back to have him paint our whole 5000+ sq ft home interior, including drywall repairs. I couldn’t be happier with the results and experience. If you need real pros who will do whatever it takes to meet your expectations, call L&P painting. I enthusiastically recommend them to anyone looking for quality painting at very reasonable rates. Ken Johns

reviews.author: Jenn Lowe
reviews.text: My entire downstairs and kitchen desperately needed a new paint job and Loni and his crew absolutely delivered! They took care of everything from getting the paint needed, taking good care of my furniture and cabinets, cleaning up the blemishes on the walls, trim, and doors before painting, and gave me a flawless final product. I'm very happy with Loni's responsiveness, the price, the professionalism, and the crew's work. I highly recommend LP Painting Services!

reviews.author: Sandra Barnes
reviews.text: LP Painting & Home Improvement is a treasure to find. We had our kitchen, dining room, living area, hallway and bathroom painted in a day. The crew was very professional, polite and seemed to really enjoy doing their tasks. Lonnie's recommendations were greatly appreciated. The crew took great care in covering our furniture, flooring and filling in spots on the walls. They were punctual, reliable and unlike any other service I have encountered. The price was fair, the job was excellent and I highly recommend LP Painting & Home Improvements for all your needs.

reviews.author: Chris Hale
reviews.text: Loni and his crew did an excellent job in our home. We had the whole house painted, crown molding, chair rail, and some other small tasks completed. This house was a double-wide so we also had all the drywall moldings where the drywall met removed, mudded, and taped so the walls would be smooth like any other home. Needless to say, even with all the challenges of the wall surfaces and angles, they did an excellent job. It did take a little longer than expected, but Loni made sure the job was done right and made daily visits to inspect work done. They even had no problems working around other contractors we had installing windows and doors. We would highly recommend LP Painting Services to anyone.

reviews.author: Todd B
reviews.text: We chose LP Painting because of the multiple 5-star ratings and the testimonials. Lonny was responsive and quick to meet to provide an estimate and the price he provided was very reasonable for the amount of work that needed to be done. Lonny's crew went above and beyond for the job! We were impressed with the quality of work, the attention to detail, and how well they cleaned up after the job was finished. I highly recommend LP Painting to anyone who is looking for the quality of work for the best price.

reviews.author: Amy Pent
reviews.text: We used LP Painting Services to paint 12 buildings last year. We are impressed with Loni's professionalism, quality, value, and responsiveness. I recommend him to everyone I can and wish him all the best. I would not consider using anyone else. He guarantees his work and that is unheard of in this day and age. His integrity and "can do" attitude make him a joy to work with. If you are looking for a professional to paint for you, give him a call. I know you will be happy you did. I am!

reviews.author: Earl Johnson
reviews.text: Lonnie and his team are just great!! They painted our decks and repaired rotten planks and were very thorough and professional. They asked repeatedly if there was anything more that we needed and took care of everything. Great working with him. Highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Mike Grotenhuis
reviews.text: Very pleased with the work Lonnie and crew completed at our house. They expertly repaired a lot of damaged interior walls and then did a complete paint job to the main areas inside our house. Great attention to detail. Lonnie's crew was very respectful, diligent, and made sure to protect all of our furniture and belongings. We could not be happier!

reviews.author: Siri Zwemke
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible work by this team of dedicated professionals. We had the entire exterior painted and they were here to start on a holiday weekend, pressure washing and caulking. Worked on Labor Day. The attention to detail and care was amazing. They were very careful about the many plants around the house. Polite, asked questions, and did both a speedy but absolutely perfect job. Highly recommend, even if you have to wait your turn, because they are popular!

reviews.author: Lori M
reviews.text: I highly recommend LP Painting Services & Home Improvement. My only regret is that I didn't call them first! Three months after hiring the wrong person, I thankfully discovered LP Painting. Loni and his crew came in, and in 2 weeks transformed my old, tired 70s house into a beautiful, updated, upgraded farmhouse chic home, living room, dining room, family room, and kitchen. Not only that, our garage ceiling started falling in, and they completely replaced the ceiling in our garage. They were professional, prompt, courteous, and skilled. Also, they were fast! They came in and hit the ground running and didn't stop until the job was done and we were happy with everything. Initially, I had a little tinge of sticker shock at the quote, but seriously, when you consider the quality of work, and that you end up with something you love, it was so inexpensive. Absolutely well worth it! I will definitely be hiring them again.

reviews.author: Mia Petree
reviews.text: Loni is a true professional and takes pride in his work. He's responsive, communicative, and he and his team did a great job painting several rooms in my house, including kitchen and cabinets. They were friendly, prompt, finished when they said they would, stuck to their estimate (which was competitive with another local contractor's bid), made excellent suggestions along the way, cleaned up after themselves nicely. There were a few punchlist items which they completed promptly and cheerfully. Loni wants his clients to be happy with his work, and I am. I'll definitely call him the next time we need to paint.

reviews.author: Zack
reviews.text: We have used Loni several times and he and his crew are great to work with they are very dependable and very quality contious and detailed on there work. I highly recomend using them for any painting or home improvements. i wish i would have found them sooner on earlier projects i always have refered them to my nebiors and they were very happy as well. And we will be using LP Painting services agin

reviews.author: Marti Vose
reviews.text: Highly recommend LP Painting! We worked with them on two different interior paint jobs. Both times they were professional, polite and very efficient. Loni and his whole crew are very considerate of the client and their home. Will definitely use again.

reviews.author: Laura Burt
reviews.text: Lonnie and his crew did an absolutely fantastic job on our rental 3 level townhome. Great price and immaculate paint job. His crew were very polite and professional. They did a great job preparing the surfaces and showed great attention to detail. The accent walls they painted came out beautifully with clean, sharp corners, no smudges or mistakes. Beautiful. We will be using LP Painting for all our properties.

reviews.author: Steve Petrides
reviews.text: As a former paint contractor, it was very difficult for me to hand over my home to another contractor. Loni and his crew more than exceeded my expectations. They are punctual, stay on the job until it is done and do a fantastic job. I've used them on two projects so far and getting ready to start my third. I've also recommended LP Painting to everyone I know. It's hard to find a contractor these days who delivers on what they promise and do an excellent job-LP Painting does both.

reviews.author: E Hodge
reviews.text: I found LP Painting as a result of the various searches conducted online. Lonnie was extremely responsive to our request for quotes for interior and exterior painting. He came out immediately and provided a comprehensive quote for all services we needed as well as recommendations for supporting service contractors as well. Once we pulled the trigger Lonnie was communicative and moved swiftly to set a date. His team arrived promptly , evaluated any preparation and moved swiftly to begin site prep, and touch ups. By the end of day two they’d finished our cathedral ceilings, two story foyer and common areas and all the doors and trim. Additionally, I work from home and the team had a strong respect for times I needed go through the work area and made sure they had a safe environment for my family. The job was completed professionally, the clean-up was done completely and efficiently. The team was friendly and professional throughout. We cannot wait for Spring so that they can start the exterior painting and decking rework! Strongly recommend Lonnie and his team for any painting project.

reviews.author: Rodger Swedenburg
reviews.text: It was a very positive experience selecting LP Painting. From the initial request to paint an entire floor of my home, Loni was responsive, came out to assess the job, and gave us the price for the job, and stuck to it. I appreciate his professionalism, and in my opinion (although I do very little "outsourcing" for my home projects) went above and beyond, doing pre work (additional wall repairs that I attempted and they "completed") that I didn't expect them to do. Professional team, got right to work, quick and great work, cleaned up after done, and even went back and did some trim painting I'd forgotten to tell him about after they were done. I would use his services in the future with no reservations.

reviews.author: Rhonda Carper
reviews.text: We had some painting to do and called 3 companies. Two companies came out to provide estimates, but never followed through on the work. When I called Lonnie, he responded that afternoon. He came by the house to give me an estimate and we arranged for the painting to be done the following week. We had two rooms and adjoining ceilings and a staircase to paint. His crew showed up and did an amazing job. When Lonnie inspected the painting on their last day, he noticed a small imperfection at the top corner beside a kitchen cabinet. He got a ladder and touched it up on the spot. He wanted to be sure we were satisfied and pleased with the work. I'm definitely calling Lonnie back in the spring to do some additional painting. Quality workmanship at a fair price. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kara Muegge
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about Loni and his team, Marlon and Omar. We are currently in the process of finishing our basement. Nothing is worse than having someone do a botch job then having to go out and try to find someone to fix it that you can trust. Loni came in and repaired all of the drywall and repainted everything in a weeks time for a reasonable price. We are thrilled with the results!! I agree with all of the other reviews here. Can’t say enough about the professionalism, timeliness, quality and detail of work! I definitely recommend LP Painting. Loni stands by his work and wants the customer to be completely satisfied. Thank you so much for an outstanding job.

reviews.author: Mrs. Fields
reviews.text: Lonnie and his workers are the best hands down !!! Very respectable and professional he has been in this profession since 1986 and his work speaks for itself . His crew takes time and makes sure your job is done correctly , lonnie the owner even does a walk through before you see it to make sure its correct and professional . Hes impeckable service , hes great at crown moldings and new dry wall my paint looks like velvet!!! I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a paint job wether its small or large!!

reviews.author: Ed Jenkins
reviews.text: We have used Lonnie and his team on several occasions for interior painting, drywall repair, exterior painting. I am a retired construction superintendent and I recognize quality work. I recommend LP Painting to family, friends, and anyone looking for top quality work. His team is very professional and their work is exceptional and they do an excellent clean-up after their work is completed. When the job is completed Lonnie walks with you to make sure everything is satisfactory.

reviews.author: Ellie Keane
reviews.text: A few years ago Lonnie and his crew painted the interior of my home including all trim and doors. We were so pleased with the job they did that my daughter recently hired them too. Their work is impeccable. The crew was polite and considerate. They took great care to protect our belongings during each service. I will use this service again. Great job Lonnie!!!

reviews.author: Zachary Freeman
reviews.text: Lonnie's estimate was half of what another company quoted us. We thought this is too good to be true and were suspicious but we checked all the reviews and they were all fantastic so we went ahead and hired him and his team. Now after completing through interior of our home (walls, ceiling and trim) we r joining the long list of fantastic reviews. The job was done within through time frame Lonnie gave us. Lonnie and Mellissa was very responsive to emails. His crew was clean, on time, efficient and very responsive. Every time we noticed something and asked them to fix it up they did it without question. We were very appreciative that their goal really seemed to be that they wanted us happy. Would highly recommended! Thank you to Lonnie and the team of L&P painting.

reviews.author: Lynn Lineberger
reviews.text: Loni and his crew have always been professional and took great care while working in our home. He has painted most of our house, inside as well as the garage (and performed a rescue repair!) and installed beautiful molding in our lower level. All to his exacting standard and no time wasted. He doesn’t over promise, and wants to be sure the customer is happy. My husband says he has painted his last wall! Thank you Loni!

reviews.author: Michelle North
reviews.text: After meeting with 4 painting contractors, we chose L&P Painting to paint the exterior of our 2 1/2 story, 30 year old, wood-sided home. The crew’s work ethic and attention to detail was impressive. In addition to painting, there was a significant amount of prep work required which included replacing rotted wood and lots of sanding. We couldn’t be more pleased with the finished results and highly recommend Loni and his crew!

reviews.author: Cathei Jock
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the work that was done in my salon! They went above and beyond to make it look perfect! Very professional and efficient as well as being reasonably priced! I would highly recommend them for any of your needs!

reviews.author: Barbara Caceres
reviews.text: We needed the ceilings of the porches and overhang around our entire house stained. I was nervous about any spills on the stucco, so I needed painters who would be very careful. Loni's team worked carefully and quickly to get the job done. The work was perfect, looks wonderful, and everything was tidy when they left. The job finished earlier than expected so Loni adjusted the price. I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Pamela Clark
reviews.text: We used LP Painting Services to paint our two story family room, ceiling, hallways and kitchen. They did a fantastic job! They were incredibly helpful, professional, and responsive every step of the way. We look forward to doing business with LP Painting Services again.

reviews.author: jeff clark
reviews.text: Have used L.P painting multiple times and have given to my sons family also to use. As always job was done top notch and no issues that I have ever had were addressed and taken care of during the jobs. You want it done right and good then call Lonnie at L.P. Painting . You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: William Blalock
reviews.text: We cannot say enough good things about Lonnie and his company. They are professional, knowledgeable, on-time, and conscientious of the homeowners. This most recent job included our kitchen, family room, living room, and garage. They made every effort to have us back in business in our kitchen at the end of the first day which was really appreciated (we didn't ask for it and expected to have the kitchen out of service for the duration of the job). Lonnie's team is organized, extremely talented, and they work well together. They are flexible, adding components to the job last minute seamlessly. We could not be happier with the results and look forward to having them back for additional work in the near future. If we could give more than 5 stars, we would!

reviews.author: Sam Cliffton
reviews.text: As a custom home Designer and Builder in the area since 1978, I have come to appreciate subcontractors who I don't have to babysit and who are committed to top notch work at a fair price. I have used LP Painting on several projects both large and small. They have consistently done an excellent job in a timely manner. Loni Pease has also managed to retain a group of top notch employees through the years - a good sign in my book. I highly recommend them for your next project.

reviews.author: Gina Miller
reviews.text: Loni and his crew did a great job on our home. They came in and quickly painted the interior and several exterior doors so that we could put our home on the market right away. It looked so fresh and clean. They painted the entire place in just one week. Loni worked right alongside his team and they used quality paints.

reviews.author: Bruce McDaniel
reviews.text: Loni and his team have been our painters for over 20 years! Consistently, they do a great job and we are always very satisfied. We highly recommend L P Painting. Lonnie takes pride in doing quality work and having a satisfied customer. We found his team to be respectful, reliable, and very competent. If you are considering a painter, L P Painting does quality work.

reviews.author: Anna McFalls
reviews.text: L.P. Painting did an excellent job for us. This was our second experience. We recommend them for anyone looking for quality work.

reviews.author: TommyToy TV
reviews.text: Lonnie was very easy to work with. The crew of painters were exceptionally skilled and very detail oriented. LP Painting came through for us when we needed someone on a time crunch. They went out of their way to make time to complete our entire interior by our deadline - at a time when other painters wouldn't even see us for months. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Chandler Crowe
reviews.text: Lonnie and his crew painted our entire house 10+ years ago and they did such a quality job we had them return a few months ago to paint our remodeled basement. Their work was flawless which means a lot because I am incredibly picky. They got the job done timely and they were very neat. I highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Douglas Ward
reviews.text: Just finished a major outdoor painting job with LP Painting. They did a great job; good attention to detail, cleaned up, finished on time before our big party. Did a number of little extras at no additional charge. Loni is great to work with.Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jennifer Pickering
reviews.text: We just finished building our new home in Culpeper County. The builder sprayed all the walls and trim one color. I received several quotes from local painters to customize the interior paint in the entire house. Loni was amazing from our initial conversation! He was readily available to come on site to provide a quote and followed up with us afterwards to see if he could answer any questions or if we would like to move forward. His crew is phenomenal! I felt comfortable leaving the house to run errands, etc. They were on time, professional, courteous, friendly and polite. They kept all areas neat and tidy as they were working and made sure to tuck everything neatly and out of the way each afternoon when they left. They bent over backwards to make sure everything was perfect! Highly recommend Loni and his crew! 10 stars isn’t nearly enough!

reviews.author: Amith
reviews.text: They did an amazing job painting our entire home interior. Clean painting lines and thorough work with all the trim and doors. Patched up and refinished all drywall issues. Completed the job ahead of schedule. Will definitely recommend LP Painting to anyone!!

reviews.author: Amy Inskeep
reviews.text: Loni and his crew did an EXCELLENT job on our house. We have an older home (built in 1955, my husband's childhood home) and it has different types of walls (some plaster, some sheetrock) with multiple additions which you can see where each addition was added. They were able to correct the flaws in the walls and ceilings to make them look brand new and continuous. They removed a wallpaper border without damaging the existing surface. (it was on there pretty good). The painting was flawless, paying attention to the complete covering of the prior bold color that needed to go. My husband was especially impressed with the basement step walls. He said it never looked that good when he was growing up in the house! All in all a very pleasant and stress free experience. Loni and everyone in his crew were courteous, very mindful of the furnishings in the house and just an overall pleasure to work with. I feel like we have a brand new house! Definitely will work with them again when the opportunity arises!

reviews.author: JESSICA CHERENZIA
reviews.text: We hired LP Painting to paint the main floor of our home. They have great attention to detail, were polite, respectful and professional. They did a fantastic job and were mindful of our schedule and needs. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Joe Karwoski
reviews.text: Loni was very quick to reply. Came out and looked at the work we needed, gave us an estimate and followed up. His workers were prompt, hard working and cleaned everything up. We were very pleased with the quality of the work, the materials used, the price and the follow through! We highly recommend L.P. Painting Services. We would use L.P. Painting Services again!

reviews.author: robbie porath
reviews.text: Loni gave us a fair price. His guys did great work. They told me exactly when they would be done and they were right on schedule. Loni was very responsive anytime we reached out to him. We will definitely use their services again and recommend them for anyone else looking for painting services.

reviews.author: Carly Plumley
reviews.text: Loni and his team did an incredible job with stucco removal and painting the interior of our home. Loni was very responsive, reasonably priced, and professional. The job finished right on target with his estimated timeframe, and we couldn’t be more pleased with the outcome! We will definitely use Loni for any future needs.

reviews.author: Mathieu Cremieux
reviews.text: I just bought a house in madison, and when the house vacated, I noticed how bad the walls looked! There is no way I have time to take on a painting project, so I asked the folks at Sherwin williams if they could recommend someone. They gave me Lonnie's number, and I am so appreciative they did. From the very first phone call, Lonnie was professional and knowledgeable. He gave me a reasonable estimate and quickly worked me into his busy schedule. His communication was stellar, keeping me informed of progress the whole job. His crew was neat and efficient. I actually accidentally dropped in on them at one point because I had to drop some moving boxes off, and didn't realize they'd be at it already. I hate to interrupt workers, but the crew was very nice and didn't mind showing off the work. They obviously take pride in the good job they do. Everything looks amazing, and they cleaned up everything when they were done. I am very pleased and highly recommend Lonnie's company.

reviews.author: Janet Stallions
reviews.text: Loni and team did an excellent job on the exterior of our home. Also, he repaired our wooden ramp and railing for a very reasonable fee. He has a great carpenter. Loni offers one stop shopping so that you don't need to coordinate contractors. DO NOT HESITATE to call him as he has so much painting experience that you are in good hands. He knew just what to apply to the nail heads that were leaving rust on our siding because the builders didn't use the correct nails. Loni didn't need to go to the paint store and ask questions like the other contractor that we got a quote from. Experience matters and it saved me time and money in the long run. He traveled from Culpeper to Haymarket for us and is looking for work in our area. He doesn't upcharge you if you live in a nice neighborhood. His prices were VERY REASONABLE and he is easy to communicate with as he wants to make sure the job is done right.

reviews.author: Lisa DeMelfi
reviews.text: LP Painting transformed the interior of my home. They worked quickly with every attention to detail. Everyone was very accommodating with me being home every day. I truly have no complaints and could not be happier with the results. They are simply the best and my husband and I will use them again and again for future painting needs. Thank you so much for making our house feel like home!

reviews.author: Matt Erickson
reviews.text: Loni is great to work with! He did a big job for me and was communicative and responsive the entire time. The crew was easy to work with and respectful. I definitely recommend LP Painting Services!

reviews.author: Brian Bouffard
reviews.text: Loni came to the house to give an estimate. The estimate was fair and Loni seemed to want the job. I accepted the estimate and he promised to do the job in a week or two. When that didn’t happen, I called and he apologized and rescheduled. Again it did not happen. I called and rescheduled again. I have not heard from him since. If you can’t do the job at least let the customer know. Very frustrating as I need to find another painter and take more of my time getting estimates.

reviews.author: Daniel Fiero
reviews.text: I wish I could give zero stars to this contractor. We entrusted them with painting our home, only for them to turn out to be a complete disaster. After agreeing on the job, they had us drive 45 minutes each way to pick out a color from their affiliated Benjamin Moore store, which we did with high hopes. Little did we know, that was just the beginning of our nightmare. After choosing the color, this contractor completely ghosted us. No response to our calls, texts, or emails, just total silence. It was as if they vanished into thin air, leaving us in a lurch. We were forced into a last-minute scramble to find another contractor, and thankfully, we did find someone who delivered excellent work. However, the stress and frustration caused by this contractor’s unprofessionalism were completely unnecessary and could have been avoided. Save yourself the trouble and steer clear of this contractor. They clearly lack respect for their clients and basic business ethics. Our experience was nothing short of infuriating and a significant waste of time and energy.

reviews.author: John Garner
reviews.text: I used LP Painting to paint the interior of my home and to add crown molding. The team was very precise, clean, and tidied up at the end of each day. All in all, I'd describe my experience with LP Painting as high quality work at a fair price. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tim Martin
reviews.text: I was referred to Lonnie and his team when I was looking at paint colors at the Paint Bucket in Culpeper. After meeting with Lonnie and discussing my request, he was able to provide an immediate quote and we decided to move forward with this project. Lonnie was very clear with his communication around start dates and timelines and what to expect during the process. My project was completed yesterday, and I could not be happier with the end result. I recognized during the process that I made an error in paint colors and was able to change my choices and the job was still completed on time and with impeccable results. Will definitely be using Lonnie and his team again when it is time for the next project.

reviews.author: angela layden
reviews.text: We contacted LP Painting services after they came highly recommended by others in the area. The quality and professionalism was above any other company we have used. After contacting the company, our entire project was completed within a week of our first meeting. We could not be happier with their work! Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Katherine McMahon
reviews.text: I had Lonnie come out and paint our 2 story foyer and the whole downstairs. Along with adding shadow boxes to our chair rail in one room. Lonnie kept in touch through the whole process and gave us an accurate estimate. I had to stay home during a portion of work and the workers were fine with me going in and out of the kitchen occasionally. very happy with the service we received from them.

reviews.author: Annmarie Riesenberger
reviews.text: Lonnie and his crew just finished a job for me and have rehired him to paint the rest of the house. They were professional, polite, efficient and on time. Their work was excellent and I am very pleased with the quality of the work. Can't wait to have the rest of the house done. Job well done thanks.

reviews.author: Sharon Clark
reviews.text: Loni and his team did an excellent job in our store. The drywall repairs were so good you would never know we needed them. The finished project is excellent. They accommodated our schedule and offered extra help when moving displays.

reviews.author: Sarah Marshall
reviews.text: We recently hired Loni, are are extremely pleased with him and his crew. Painted exterior trim, doors, etc. also the interior. Made the interior look better than when it was built! The crew is very professional. Excellent work. Would definitely hire again.

reviews.author: Ilka Chapman
reviews.text: Hired Loni and his crew to power wash, and paint the exterior of our home. They also rehung our shutters more securely. Had them replace the outside light fixtures, fix our gate and replace the mailbox post. They did a great job. Will be contacting them again when I'm ready to do the interior painting.

reviews.author: greg fisher
reviews.text: Loni and his team were on time and very professional. They repaired nail pops, peeling drywall tape and painted interior rooms as well as painted the garage and garage floor. We were well satisfied and will be having them return for future projects. Also we found the pricing to be very competitive as well.

reviews.author: Karen Adams
reviews.text: The crew that came to our house were very professional and worked quickly. We had ceiling, walls, trim and doors done. One day I hope to have the kitchen cabinets painted and will call them to do it. They also removed an old built in radio in the wall. You can't tell it was ever there! I plan on using them again for exterior work. We were very happy with the results.

reviews.author: Walt Phillips
reviews.text: Jeffersonton United Methodist Church recently needed some extensive interior plaster, multiple wall cracks, and painting. Lonnie and his professional crew brought back life to the grand old church. They were on time, helpful and friendly, true professionals in every sense of the word. What ever the next project might be the first call will be to Lonnie.

reviews.author: Mary B
reviews.text: Wow…disappointing, dishonest and completely unreliable. Loni and crew did a pretty good job with the interior of my 1920’s farmhouse, but were in some ways careless and half of the dining room looks like it was painted by a 3rd grader. I accepted his bid for the exterior painting at the same time, and Loni kept telling me I was still on the schedule but has never showed up or called to explain. Good riddance!

reviews.author: Robert Pope
reviews.text: L.P. Painting was professional, courteous, quick, clean and friendly. Without a doubt, the very best experience with a paint company ever. Plan on having them back to do my kitchen and sunroom in the spring. Excellent value!!

reviews.author: Paint Bucket
reviews.text: We have used LP Painting services in the past and have found them to be neat, prompt and talented in their craft. I would highly recommend them to anyone who is looking for a team of professionals. We have referred them to many of our clients for the past twenty years.

reviews.author: Emily Dauch
reviews.text: LP painting services & home improvements did an amazing job painting my entire home. I couldn’t be happier with their work. They were all respectful and caring of my home. I highly recommend their services!!

reviews.author: Becky Emmott
reviews.text: LP Painting services did an outstanding job in my home. The crew was a pleasure to work with and very accommodating. Quality work for a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Victoria Shelton
reviews.text: Great professional service with a crew that works smoothly and cleanly to get the job done well and on time. We've worked with Loni on several projects, both interior and exr, since moving into our home and recommend him without reservation.

reviews.author: William Bunch
reviews.text: Loni and the LP crew did a great job at Culpeper County Airport. They painted our rotating beacon tower, 2 12000 gallon fuel tanks, and our weather tower. I would recommend them and will use them in the future.

reviews.author: Robert Johnson
reviews.text: Loni and team overhauled the exterior of my house from top to bottom, replacing old siding, filling holes, changing out old railings, re-caulking windows, scraping, sanding, priming and painting, and made the old house look like new. I couldn't have been happier with this work and cannot recommend LP Painting highly enough.

reviews.author: Bill Ingerski
reviews.text: Wife is 100% plus pleased. What else matters? This was an 8 day whole house interior project. The total team approach from planning, colors coordination, walls and ceilings preparation through completion was exemplary. The team arrived promptly each day and was attentive to meticulous cleanup. Would recommend without reservation.

reviews.author: Darla Purgason
reviews.text: These gentlemen are the best!! They painted our entire main floor, all the various rooms and two-story high expanses. They were very professional, with attention to detail, efficient, and worth every penny. We can't wait to have them do our basement when it's finished.

reviews.author: Benjamin Phillips
reviews.text: Lonnie and his crew have painted my house and my office. They do excellent work and clean up after themselves. I highly recommend them for painting and drywall repair.

reviews.author: Beth Wynacht
reviews.text: Such a great experience! We are so happy with our fresh new paint job. Not only does it look great, but the entire process was smooth and the team was a pleasure to work with. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Moving Meadows Farm
reviews.text: When we added a mother-in-law suite in our basement LP Painting did great work for us! As a business owner in downtown Culpeper I have seen their work over the last few years with various neighboring businesses and it is always first class!

reviews.author: Susan Smith
reviews.text: I own a large home with tall columns. Working with Loni and LP Painting was easy. I got quality work at a reasonable price. I highly recommend LP Painting.

reviews.author: Kiley Pease
reviews.text: This is a fantastic team that does wonderful work, they painted my house before we moved in and made everything look great!!! we cannot say enough good things about them. They are professional and have lots of experience, I will recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Angelena Hitt
reviews.text: Loni and his guys are absolutely amazing! Painted my kitchen cabinets, kitchen, and family room. Beautiful job and very professional. I will be using LP Painting in the future!

reviews.author: Theresa Thomas
reviews.text: As a color consultant, I've worked with Loni, LP Painting for over 20 yrs. He, and his crew are always professional and have the clients best interest in mind.

reviews.author: Sharon Brani
reviews.text: I had two houses painted by Loni and his men. Everything from beginning to end was smooth. He listened to all my concerns and did an amazing job. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Sue Calemine
reviews.text: Lonnie’s team did a fabulous job. Painting is superb, cleanup and job was completed ahead a schedule. I highly recommend LP Painting

reviews.author: Michael Vignola
reviews.text: Removed 2 layers of wall paper. Then prepped the walls for painting. Also painted the ceilings and trim on my hall, foyer and stairway. Excellent job. Local, reasonable and professional. Highly recommend Lonnie.

reviews.author: Judith Plescow
reviews.text: I can not say enough positive things about L.P. Painting Services. The are responsive, their pricing is competitive and fair and the quality of their work is above reproach. I have and will continue to refer them.

reviews.author: Matt Murphy
reviews.text: LP painting was fantastic. They were extremely Responsive, very clean and did a very professional painting job. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text: Lonnie and his crew of professionals not only did a great job going above and beyond but finished a day ahead of schedule. I am looking forward to working with them again on my next painting project!

reviews.author: Marta Hill Gray
reviews.text: Outstanding work. This was our second time using LP Painting and they went above and beyond. I would highly recommend this business. I am having them paint my exterior later this year. Excellent!

reviews.author: Thomas Heslep
reviews.text: This company did a great job painting and repairing some drywall, and re-taping. They did the job over a weekend, finished sooner than we expected, and did quality work. TTHeslep

reviews.author: Ann Baugher
reviews.text: Lonnie and his crew were professional,on time, and respectful of my handicap and time constraints for me. I am thrilled to have found this company. We are using them again!

reviews.author: Peter Samson
reviews.text: Lonnie and his crew did a thorough, excellent job with attention to detail. They were real pros and a pleasure to deal with. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Richard Evans
reviews.text: Have used this company on a number of home projects over the last few years. I have always received exceptional work at a reasonable price. Will definitely use them in the future.

reviews.author: C Southey
reviews.text: Super happy with LP Painting - they did a fantastic job painting the ceilings, walls and trim in my kitchen and family room.

reviews.author: Ben Cranford
reviews.text: I've worked with LP Painting for a few years now. I have recommended him to a lot of people and the people that use them are always happy.

reviews.author: Hans Murdock
reviews.text: The crew came in and got right to work. They finished early and cleaned up. They did a great job and we will use them again.

reviews.author: Elena Enescu
reviews.text: Reliable, dependable, trustworthy, professional, outstanding job. We will use the services again for all future projects, and are highly recommending this business.

reviews.author: Mladen Stoychev
reviews.text: They did interior painting in my house, made everything look much better. They are highly recommended

reviews.author: Joan Herrema
reviews.text: Excellent job. Quick and clean. Reasonable price finished product "beautiful" Crew were great Look forward to next job

reviews.author: Brittley McGrath
reviews.text: Very pleased with the work this company did. They are very knowledgeable and hard workers. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: John Grano
reviews.text: Loni Piazzi and his team of skilled artisans remind me of what it was like when I grew up in Connecticut in my Italian neighborhood. My dad and his peers were proud of what they knew how to do and always delivers their finest work. This local company is a an old school gem.
